CustomField.description: This field will be the adjusted Volume for Merchant Deals. Used in Calculating Reps Commission.
CustomField.formula: IF( Actual_Points_Earned__c > 10.99, ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c, IF(Actual_Points_Earned__c > 6.99, ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c * 2/3, ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c * 1/3))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will be the adjusted Volume for Merchant Deals. Used in Calculating Reps Commission.
CustomField.label: Actual Merchant Adjusted Volume
